```luau
--!strict
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config")) :: any
local Telemetry = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ForgeTelemetry")) :: any

local Tycoon = {}
Tycoon.__index = Tycoon

local NEED_TOAST_INTERVAL = 3

local function getNotifyRemote(): RemoteEvent
	local folder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(Config.REMOTES_FOLDER)
	if not folder then
		local newFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
		newFolder.Name = Config.REMOTES_FOLDER
		newFolder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
		folder = newFolder
	end
	local f = folder :: Instance
	local remote = f:FindFirstChild(Config.REMOTE_NOTIFY)
	if not remote then
		local newRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
		newRemote.Name = Config.REMOTE_NOTIFY
		newRemote.Parent = f
		remote = newRemote
	end
	return remote :: RemoteEvent
end

local function getCash(player: Player): IntValue?
	if not player.Parent then
		return nil
	end
	local stats: Instance? = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not stats then
		local newStats = Instance.new("Folder")
		newStats.Name = "leaderstats"
		newStats.Parent = player
		stats = newStats
	end
	local s = stats :: Instance
	local cash: Instance? = s:FindFirstChild("Cash")
	if not cash then
		local newCash = Instance.new("IntValue")
		newCash.Name = "Cash"
		newCash.Value = 0
		newCash.Parent = s
		cash = newCash
	end
	if cash and cash:IsA("IntValue") then
		return cash
	end
	return nil
end

function Tycoon.new(player: Player, plot: any): any
	local self: any = setmetatable({}, Tycoon)
	self.player = player
	self.plot = plot
	self.destroyed = false
	self.speed = Config.CONVEYOR_SPEED
	self.cubes = {} :: { [Instance]: boolean }
	self.cubeCount = 0
	self.connections = {} :: { RBXScriptConnection }
	self.bought = { dropper = false, conveyor = false }
	self.notify = getNotifyRemote()

	-- Starting bankroll so the first upgrade is reachable within ~30s.
	if not player:GetAttribute("StartCashGranted") then
		local startCash = Config.START_CASH
		if type(startCash) ~= "number" then
			startCash = 10
		end
		local cash = getCash(player)
		if cash then
			cash.Value += startCash
		end
		player:SetAttribute("StartCashGranted", true)
	end

	local flat = Vector3.new(plot.conveyorDir.X, 0, plot.conveyorDir.Z)
	self.dir = if flat.Magnitude > 0.001 then flat.Unit else Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)

	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "Cubes_" .. player.UserId
	folder.Parent = Workspace
	self.folder = folder

	self.activeDroppers = { plot.droppers[1] }

	-- Heartbeat: drive cubes along the conveyor, collect at the end, clean up strays.
	table.insert(self.connections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		self:_step()
	end))

	-- Collector touch
	table.insert(self.connections, plot.collector.Touched:Connect(function(hit: BasePart)
		if hit:IsA("Part") and self.cubes[hit] then
			self:_collect(hit)
		end
	end))

	self:_wireButton(plot.dropperButton, "dropper", Config.DROPPER_COST, function(): string
		local slot2 = plot.droppers[2] or plot.dropperSlot2
		if slot2 then
			slot2.Transparency = 0
			slot2.Color = Config.DROPPER_COLOR
			table.insert(self.activeDroppers, slot2)
		end
		Telemetry.count("dropper_bought", 1)
		return "Second dropper bought!"
	end)
	self:_wireButton(plot.conveyorButton, "conveyor", Config.CONVEYOR_COST, function(): string
		self.speed = Config.FAST_CONVEYOR_SPEED
		Telemetry.count("conveyor_bought", 1)
		return "Faster conveyor bought!"
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		while not self.destroyed do
			for _, dropper in ipairs(self.activeDroppers) do
				self:_spawnCube(dropper)
			end
			task.wait(Config.DROP_INTERVAL)
		end
	end)

	return self
end

function Tycoon._spawnCube(self: any, dropper: BasePart)
	if self.destroyed or self.cubeCount >= Config.MAX_CUBES_PER_PLOT then
		return
	end
	local conveyor: BasePart = self.plot.conveyor
	local dir: Vector3 = self.dir
	local half: number = Config.CONVEYOR_LENGTH / 2 - 2
	local t = math.clamp((dropper.Position - conveyor.Position):Dot(dir), -half, half)
	local pos = conveyor.Position + dir * t
	local y = conveyor.Position.Y + conveyor.Size.Y / 2 + Config.CUBE_SIZE.Y / 2 + 0.5
	local cube = Instance.new("Part")
	cube.Name = "Cube"
	cube.Size = Config.CUBE_SIZE
	cube.Color = Config.CUBE_COLOR
	cube.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	cube.Anchored = false
	cube.CanCollide = true
	cube.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(pos.X, y, pos.Z))
	cube:SetAttribute("Value", Config.CUBE_VALUE)
	cube:SetAttribute("OwnerId", (self.player :: Player).UserId)
	cube:SetAttribute("Born", os.clock())
	cube.Parent = self.folder
	pcall(function()
		cube:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
	end)
	self.cubes[cube] = true
	self.cubeCount += 1
	Telemetry.count("cubes_dropped", 1)
end

function Tycoon._removeCube(self: any, cube: BasePart)
	if self.cubes[cube] then
		self.cubes[cube] = nil
		self.cubeCount = math.max(0, self.cubeCount - 1)
	end
	cube:Destroy()
end

function Tycoon._collect(self: any, cube: BasePart)
	if self.destroyed or not self.cubes[cube] or cube:GetAttribute("Collected") then
		return
	end
	cube:SetAttribute("Collected", true)
	local raw = cube:GetAttribute("Value")
	local value: number = Config.CUBE_VALUE
	if type(raw) == "number" then
		value = raw
	end
	local cash = getCash(self.player)
	if cash then
		cash.Value += value
	end
	Telemetry.count("cubes_collected", 1)
	self:_removeCube(cube)
end

function Tycoon._step(self: any)
	if self.destroyed then
		return
	end
	local conveyor: BasePart = self.plot.conveyor
	local dir: Vector3 = self.dir
	local endT: number = Config.CONVEYOR_LENGTH / 2 + 1
	local now = os.clock()
	for cube in pairs(self.cubes) do
		local part = cube :: BasePart
		if not part.Parent then
			self.cubes[part] = nil
			self.cubeCount = math.max(0, self.cubeCount - 1)
		else
			local born = part:GetAttribute("Born")
			local rel = part.Position - conveyor.Position
			if part.Position.Y < conveyor.Position.Y - 30 or (type(born) == "number" and now - born > 40) then
				self:_removeCube(part)
			elseif rel:Dot(dir) >= endT then
				self:_collect(part)
			else
				local v = part.AssemblyLinearVelocity
				part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(dir.X * self.speed, v.Y, dir.Z * self.speed)
			end
		end
	end
end

function Tycoon._wireButton(self: any, button: BasePart, key: string, cost: number, onBuy: () -> string)
	local lastNeedToast = 0
	table.insert(self.connections, button.Touched:Connect(function(hit: BasePart)
		-- Already bought or torn down: ignore every further touch.
		if self.destroyed or self.bought[key] then
			return
		end
		local model = hit:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		if not model then
			return
		end
		local touchPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
		if touchPlayer == nil or touchPlayer ~= self.player then
			return
		end
		local cash = getCash(self.player)
		if not cash then
			return
		end
		if cash.Value >= cost then
			-- Mark bought BEFORE deducting so re-entrant touches cannot double-buy.
			self.bought[key] = true
			cash.Value -= cost
			button.Color = Config.BOUGHT_COLOR
			local ok, msg = pcall(onBuy)
			if ok then
				self.notify:FireClient(self.player, tostring(msg))
			else
				-- Refund and allow retry if the purchase effect failed.
				self.bought[key] = false
				cash.Value += cost
				warn("Tycoon buy failed for " .. key .. ": " .. tostring(msg))
			end
		else
			local now = os.clock()
			if now - lastNeedToast >= NEED_TOAST_INTERVAL then
				lastNeedToast = now
				self.notify:FireClient(self.player, "Need $" .. tostring(cost))
			end
		end
	end))
end

function Tycoon.destroy(self: any)
	if self.destroyed then
		return
	end
	self.destroyed = true
	for _, c in ipairs(self.connections) do
		(c :: RBXScriptConnection):Disconnect()
	end
	self.connections = {}
	self.cubes = {}
	self.cubeCount = 0
	if self.folder then
		(self.folder :: Instance):Destroy()
	end
end

return Tycoon
```

## Problem
Feature to add: Themed plots and plot claiming for multiplayer: build a bright central spawn plaza (stone tiles, a fountain, lamp posts, trees) with 6 plots arranged in a ring around it. Each plot has its own theme with distinct floor material, colors and 3-5 decoration props built from parts: Candy (pink/mint, lollipops), Lava (basalt + glowing neon cracks), Ice (glacier/ice, crystals), Jungle (grass, palm trees), Neon City (dark slate floor, neon strips), Desert (sand, cacti). No grey or default-colored parts anywhere: the conveyor rails, dropper bodies and pads take the plot's theme colors. Players spawn in the plaza and walk onto a glowing CLAIM gate at the front of an empty plot (BillboardGui 'Claim <Theme> Plot') to claim it; the plot then shows a sign with the owner's name, starts the dropper, and only the owner can use its pads. One plot per player; a player's plot is freed when they leave. If a player has not claimed within 20 seconds, auto-claim the nearest free plot for them so the loop always starts.
Change needed in this file: Stop auto-starting a dropper for each joining player. Expose startPlot(player, plot) (called by PlotClaimService on claim) that starts the dropper loop and collector for that plot, and stopPlot(plot) to halt it and clear its cubes. In the buy-pad Touched handlers, first require PlotClaimService.isOwner(player, plot) and ignore non-owners. Keep the existing per-player debounce and the check-and-deduct step.
New feature files: ReplicatedStorage/PlotThemes.luau, ServerScriptService/PlazaBuilder.luau, ServerScriptService/PlotClaimService.luau. Bump ForgeTelemetry counters: plaza_built, themes_built, plots_claimed, auto_claims.

## Context
Watch cubes roll down your conveyor, cash in, and buy droppers and speed upgrades to grow your tiny factory!

## Lessons from past builds
# Lessons
## Design
- Tune early progression so a playtest of roughly 15 seconds can reach the first purchase or milestone. Use a fast starting income or a cheap first upgrade (a few seconds of income). Slow openings leave the buy loop untested and feel dull.
- Give per-event feedback for every economy action: a "+N" popup on collect, plus HUD hints for upgrade cost, affordability or progress. Without it, numbers going up feels weak between purchases.
- Place trigger pads (buy pads, etc.) off the spawn path so walking from spawn never fires them accidentally.

## Luau and Roblox APIs
- The base place is empty: build the map from code (Instance.new Parts, Anchored = true, parented to Workspace).
- Get services with game:GetService("Players") etc.; use task.wait / task.spawn / task.delay, never wait / spawn / delay.
- Players.PlayerAdded can fire before your script connects in a playtest: also loop over Players:GetPlayers() once at startup.
- Wait for characters with player.CharacterAdded (and player.Character if already present); use WaitForChild with a timeout across the client/server boundary.
- ModuleScripts must return exactly one value (usually a table); require them by path, e.g. require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config")).
- Create RemoteEvents on the server in one place; clients only WaitForChild them and handle nil after the timeout.
- Bump counters for key gameplay events with require(ReplicatedStorage.ForgeTelemetry).count("name", 1) (server only) so playtests can verify the core loop. Include counters for purchases and other branches that need verification.
- Touched fires many times per touch: debounce per player (a per-player cooldown or a one-time purchased flag) and check and deduct cost in the same step to prevent double-buys or double-spends.

## Fixing and debugging
- A "sync" StudioError about not being able to serve a path is an infrastructure or environment failure, not a code bug. Do not change game code in response. Retry the step.
- If the critic says a code path was never exercised in the playtest, fix the pacing or setup so the path actually runs (e.g. cheaper first purchase) instead of only adding more code.

## UI kit (house style for all UI: paste the snippets you use, Theme first, and adapt; plain Luau, not modules)
- Chunky text: every label gets a dark UIStroke (2.5-4 px). LuckiestGuy for titles/numbers, FredokaOne for body. Never default or thin fonts.
- One palette everywhere: yellow Primary = main action, green Good = affordable/claim, red Bad = close/can't, blue Info = secondary, dark Ink outlines.
- Depth: UICorner 12-18 px, UIStroke border, light-top UIGradient fill, hard drop shadow 4-6 px below.
- Everything moves: appear with a Back-eased UIScale pop (0 -> 1), react with a punch (1.2 -> 1), press squish to 0.9. Tween UIScale, not Size; 0.1-0.4 s, never linear.
- Numbers tick up and pop on change, big values short ("12.5K"); gains flash green, losses red.
- Every action gives feedback: toast, floating "+N" or reward popup. Max 3 toasts.
- Mobile first: 1280x720 offsets under a viewport UIScale (`Theme.screen`), safe insets, buttons >= 44 px, nothing key in the top-left (Roblox menu).
- HUD hugs the edges, centre stays clear; windows open over a dim backdrop with a close X.
- World prices on BillboardGuis: green when affordable, red when not.
- UI is built in code with Instance.new, no image asset ids (emoji/letters for icons), ResetOnSpawn = false.

```luau
-- PriceBillboard: world price tag over a buy pad / shop item; green when affordable, red when not. Server or client.
-- Standalone (no Theme needed) so a server Script can paste it too.
local function priceBillboard(part: BasePart, title: string, price: number): (BillboardGui, (boolean) -> ())
	local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bb.Size, bb.StudsOffset = UDim2.fromScale(6, 2.2), Vector3.new(0, part.Size.Y / 2 + 2, 0)
	bb.AlwaysOnTop, bb.MaxDistance, bb.LightInfluence = false, 80, 0
	bb.Adornee = part
	local function text(t: string, y: number, h: number, color: Color3): TextLabel
		local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		l.Size, l.Position, l.BackgroundTransparency = UDim2.fromScale(1, h), UDim2.fromScale(0, y), 1
		l.Text, l.Font, l.TextScaled, l.TextColor3 = t, Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy, true, color
		local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		s.Thickness, s.Color = 3, Color3.fromRGB(28, 22, 38)
		s.Parent = l
		l.Parent = bb
		return l
	end
	text(title, 0, 0.45, Color3.fromRGB(255, 248, 232))
	local cost = text("$" .. tostring(price), 0.45, 0.55, Color3.fromRGB(240, 68, 64))
	bb.Parent = part
	local function setAffordable(ok: boolean)
		cost.TextColor3 = if ok then Color3.fromRGB(88, 214, 92) else Color3.fromRGB(240, 68, 64)
	end
	return bb, setAffordable -- client: call setAffordable(cash.Value >= price) on cash.Changed
end
```

```luau
	table.insert(self.connections, button.Touched:Connect(function(hit: BasePart)
		-- Already bought or torn down: ignore every further touch.
		if self.destroyed or self.bought[key] then
			return
		end
		local model = hit:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		if not model then
			return
		end
		local touchPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
		if touchPlayer == nil or touchPlayer ~= self.player then
			return
		end
		-- Only the plot's owner may use its pads.
		if not isOwner(touchPlayer, self.plot) then
			return
		end
		local cash = getCash(self.player)
		if not cash then
			return
		end
		if cash.Value >= cost then
			-- Mark bought BEFORE deducting so re-entrant touches cannot double-buy.
			self.bought[key] = true
			cash.Value -= cost
			button.Color = Config.BOUGHT_COLOR
			local ok, msg = pcall(onBuy)
			if ok then
				self.notify:FireClient(self.player, tostring(msg))
			else
				-- Refund and allow retry if the purchase effect failed.
				self.bought[key] = false
				cash.Value += cost
				button.Color = originalColor
				warn("Tycoon buy failed for " .. key .. ": " .. tostring(msg))
			end
		else
			local now = os.clock()
			if now - lastNeedToast >= NEED_TOAST_INTERVAL then
				lastNeedToast = now
				self.notify:FireClient(self.player, "Need $" .. tostring(cost))
			end
		end
	end))
end

function Tycoon.destroy(self: any)
	if self.destroyed then
		return
	end
	self.destroyed = true
	for _, c in ipairs(self.connections) do
		(c :: RBXScriptConnection):Disconnect()
	end
	self.connections = {}
	self.cubes = {}
	self.cubeCount = 0
	if self.folder then
		(self.folder :: Instance):Destroy()
		self.folder = nil
	end
	for _, fn in ipairs(self.restore) do
		pcall(fn)
	end
	self.restore = {}
	if activeByPlot[self.plot] == self then
		activeByPlot[self.plot] = nil
	end
end

-- Called by PlotClaimService when a player claims a plot: starts dropper loop, collector and pads.
function Tycoon.startPlot(player: Player, plot: any): any
	local existing = activeByPlot[plot]
	if existing then
		if existing.player == player and not existing.destroyed then
			return existing
		end
		existing:destroy()
	end
	local tycoon = Tycoon.new(player, plot)
	activeByPlot[plot] = tycoon
	tycoon:start()
	return tycoon
end

-- Halts a plot's dropper loop and clears its cubes (e.g. when its owner leaves).
function Tycoon.stopPlot(plot: any)
	local existing = activeByPlot[plot]
	if existing then
		existing:destroy()
	end
	activeByPlot[plot] = nil
end

return Tycoon
```
